document.title: Checkout regression evidence
document.summary: A compact record of tested customer flows, captured evidence, observed gaps, and the resulting release verdict.

blocks.title: Verdict
blocks.lead: The critical checkout path is ready to release.
blocks.detail: All required flows passed at desktop and mobile widths. One copy inconsistency is documented as non-blocking.

flows.name: Guest checkout
flows.detail: Card payment, confirmation, and receipt verified.

flows.name: Returning customer
flows.detail: Saved address and payment selection verified.

flows.name: Declined payment recovery
flows.detail: Inline error, retry, and successful completion verified.

items.title: Receipt label differs
items.detail: Confirmation uses “Receipt” while account history uses “Invoice.” Copy-only and non-blocking.

items.title: Slow sandbox response
items.detail: Payment sandbox added six seconds to one run; production telemetry does not show the same pattern.
